purpose: A bounded, repository-native product workflow graph for human understanding, agent context, deterministic integrity checks, and future browser-evidence linkage.

explorationInputs.role: Exploratory repository architecture input only; never authoritative for business semantics.
usefulFindings: React entry/providers/shell/router form the browser application boundary.
Company access, Supabase persistence, workspace synchronization, project/engineering controllers, financial settlement, payroll, and Assistant are major architectural areas.
The Assistant has a server handler, company AI runtime, tool loop, and prepared-action seam.
corrections: Settlement evidence is not project cost and does not create or duplicate invoice allocations.
Payroll project labor cost is separate from employee net-pay settlement basis.
Daily Site Log crew/headcount is observational and has no authoritative edge into payroll attendance.
Assistant mutations require PREPARE, human confirmation, deterministic validation, and guarded execution; there is no direct Assistant-to-database mutation edge.
Project subviews use appRouting.ts and query parameters rather than a second runtime router; engineering revision and formal history semantics are curated from source and migrations.

invariants.label: Company and RBAC isolation is authoritative
invariants.description: Business records are scoped by company membership and permission; client visibility is not a substitute for PostgreSQL RLS/RPC authorization.

invariants.label: Demo mode is isolated from production writes
invariants.description: The public /demo runtime uses deterministic local/session state and cannot become a production company or Supabase write path.

invariants.label: Verified invoice project cost is independent from cash settlement
invariants.description: Verified invoice allocations are a project-cost source. Cash settlement is payment evidence and must not create or duplicate project cost.

invariants.label: Invoice and expense corrections preserve financial history
invariants.description: Unused invoice/expense deletion is database-guarded; operational records use explicit archive or void actions; finalized history, allocations, extraction/review evidence, and confirmed settlement dependencies are never silently erased or rewritten.

invariants.label: Project labor cost is independent from employee net-pay settlement
invariants.description: Approved or paid payroll allocations provide project labor cost, while settlement eligibility and basis use employee net pay.

invariants.label: Project labor aggregate preserves payroll privacy
invariants.description: Finance and Viewer may receive confirmed/pending project labor totals through the guarded payroll.summary.read aggregate without receiving employee identity, payroll entries, rates, attendance, deductions, net pay, or allocation rows.

invariants.label: Site Log crew observation is not payroll attendance
invariants.description: Crew and headcount rows describe field presence observed by the site team; they never directly create or alter authoritative payroll attendance, timesheets, overtime, or runs.

invariants.label: Approved and paid payroll history is immutable
invariants.description: Approval, payment, locking, and voiding guards preserve payroll source snapshots, entries, allocations, and historical meaning.

invariants.label: Engineering document revision lineage is immutable
invariants.description: A new document revision preserves prior source, identity, and references; annotation deletion is represented as history rather than physical deletion.

invariants.label: Formal engineering history is preserved
invariants.description: RFI responses, submittal rounds/reviews, and Site Log lifecycle events are append-only or explicitly historical at their domain boundary.

invariants.label: Settlement reversal is additive history
invariants.description: Reversing a confirmed settlement retains its original confirmation provenance and records a reversal reason; it does not delete the original match or change project cost.

invariants.label: Assistant mutations require human confirmation and guarded execution
invariants.description: Assistant mutation tools persist a PREPARED action, require explicit confirmation, revalidate context and permissions, then execute through deterministic application handlers and guarded RPCs.

invariants.label: Reports are derived views and exports
invariants.description: Reports consume authoritative project, invoice, expense, payroll, and cash data; report screens and exports do not create a parallel financial source of truth.

nodes.label: Application entry
nodes.description: Chooses the production or isolated demo application before mounting the corresponding provider and workspace tree.

nodes.label: Authenticated production mode
nodes.description: Mounts the production application for the one company configured to this Engoryx deployment; users do not choose or switch unrelated companies.

nodes.label: Deployment configured company
nodes.description: A singleton deployment configuration resolves exactly one client company before membership and role permissions are evaluated.

nodes.label: Isolated demo mode
nodes.description: Mounts the deterministic Meridian demo tree at /demo without production authentication, Supabase queries, Storage, or company writes.

nodes.label: Workspace shell and router
nodes.description: Shared header, navigation, status/error surfaces, route dispatch, and application error boundary.

nodes.label: Deployment company context
nodes.description: The deployment-resolved company plus the authenticated user membership and effective permission snapshot; no tenant picker or unrelated company selection is authoritative.

nodes.label: User membership and role permissions
nodes.description: Membership status, role preset, explicit overrides, email access authorizations, and effective permissions returned by guarded access RPC boundaries.

nodes.label: Company RBAC and RLS guard
nodes.description: Fail-closed effective-permission checks and database-enforced company isolation for routes, records, Storage, Realtime, access administration, and RPCs.

nodes.label: Deployment company profile
nodes.description: Company-admin profile editor for the configured deployment company name, code, default currency, and timezone with read-only fallback and audited persistence.

nodes.label: Company access management
nodes.description: Settings access directory for member roles, pending email access authorizations, effective permissions, and safe self-access protection.

nodes.label: Email access preauthorization
nodes.description: Authenticated company-admin RPC creates a company-bound pending email authorization; verified-email claim creates membership without requiring SMTP. Historical delivery fields remain secondary compatibility metadata.

nodes.label: Member permission overrides
nodes.description: Role-preserving grant/deny editor backed by canonical permission catalog, company-bound membership foreign keys, caller-held-permission checks, and last-authority protection.

nodes.label: Production persistence boundary
nodes.description: Authenticated Supabase client, company-scoped persistence modules, RLS, Storage, Realtime, and guarded RPCs form the production system-of-record boundary.

nodes.label: Demo isolation guard
nodes.description: Demo state is fictional, deterministic, local/session-bound, and cannot select or write an arbitrary production company.

nodes.label: Workspace cache and Realtime synchronization
nodes.description: Loads, caches, sequences, refreshes, and reconciles company workspace groups after local actions or Realtime changes.

nodes.label: Demo landing route
nodes.description: Public entry point for the isolated Meridian demo.

nodes.label: Demo Assistant route
nodes.description: Demo-only Assistant screen using the deterministic local adapter.

nodes.label: Demo standalone Engineering Documents route
nodes.description: Demo-only standalone document register; production document control remains project-workspace scoped.

nodes.label: Dashboard route
nodes.description: Canonical Operations Dashboard route; / is normalized to this route.

nodes.label: Cash & Banking route
nodes.description: Canonical Cash & Banking route; transactionId selects a reconciliation/settlement context.

nodes.label: Projects directory route
nodes.description: Project directory and project-selection entry point.

nodes.label: Project Workspace route
nodes.description: Selected-project workspace route; view selects the current project tab.

nodes.label: Project Documents route
nodes.description: Project-scoped Engineering Documents route; docId and revId select a document revision without introducing a second router.

nodes.label: Project RFI register route
nodes.description: Project-scoped RFI register route.

nodes.label: RFI detail route
nodes.description: RFI detail is selected by the rfiId query parameter on the project RFI route.

nodes.label: Project Submittals route
nodes.description: Project-scoped Technical Submittals register route.

nodes.label: Submittal round detail route
nodes.description: Submittal detail and formal round are selected by submittalId and roundId query parameters.

nodes.label: Project Site Logs route
nodes.description: Project-scoped Daily Site Log register route.

nodes.label: Site Log detail route
nodes.description: Site Log detail is selected by siteLogId on the project Site Logs route.

nodes.label: Invoice extraction route
nodes.description: Invoice source upload/extraction entry route.

nodes.label: Gmail Inbox route
nodes.description: Email metadata and invoice-import route; Gmail remains an external connection boundary.

nodes.label: Invoices route
nodes.description: Supplier invoice directory route.

nodes.label: Invoice detail route
nodes.description: Invoice detail route with an optional safe return path.

nodes.label: Invoice review route
nodes.description: Human invoice verification route selected by invoiceId, with an optional return path.

nodes.label: Vendors route
nodes.description: Supplier/vendor directory route within the invoice operations area.

nodes.label: Payroll route
nodes.description: Canonical Payroll and Workforce route; runId selects a payroll-run detail context.

nodes.label: Payroll run detail route
nodes.description: Payroll run detail is selected by runId on the canonical Payroll route.

nodes.label: Expenses route
nodes.description: Direct project expense directory and draft-entry route.

nodes.label: Reports route
nodes.description: Operational, project-cost, payroll, cash, and export reporting route.

nodes.label: Settings route
nodes.description: Company/regional settings route subject to company settings permission.

nodes.label: Operations Dashboard
nodes.description: Read-oriented executive and project-cost surface with currency-aware KPI and activity views.

nodes.label: Dashboard derived metrics
nodes.description: Derived KPIs and activity metrics composed from projects, verified invoice allocations, confirmed payroll allocations, expenses, and cash state.

nodes.label: Projects directory
nodes.description: Searchable project register and entry point for selecting a project workspace.

nodes.label: Select project
nodes.description: Resolves a company project and navigates to its canonical workspace path.

nodes.label: Project Workspace
nodes.description: Project aggregate shell containing Overview, Documents, RFIs, Submittals, Site Logs, Invoices, Payroll, Expenses, People, and Reports tabs.

nodes.label: Project aggregate
nodes.description: Company-scoped project identity, budget, status, client, location, and lifecycle fields used as the central organizing aggregate.

nodes.label: Project correction and removal lifecycle
nodes.description: One explicit project lifecycle for unused-only deletion, history-preserving archive, and guarded reactivation without rewriting linked financial, payroll, workforce, or engineering history.

nodes.label: Authoritative project lifecycle RPC boundary
nodes.description: Database preflight and mutation boundary that derives the deployment company, checks active effective permission, locks the project, rechecks dependency counts, and writes bounded audit metadata.

nodes.label: Archived project activity guard
nodes.description: Archived projects remain queryable but reject new direct cost, workforce, import, engineering, and project-accounting activity across direct and linked child paths.

nodes.label: Project Overview
nodes.description: Project health and cost overview assembled from authoritative project-cost inputs and engineering summaries.

nodes.label: Authoritative project-cost aggregation
nodes.description: Actual project cost is composed from verified invoice allocations, approved/paid payroll allocations, and approved/paid direct expenses with currency boundaries preserved.

nodes.label: Invoice project allocation
nodes.description: Human-confirmed relational allocation from a verified invoice to one or more projects.

nodes.label: Verified invoice project-cost contribution
nodes.description: Cost contribution derived from a verified invoice allocation; cash payment evidence does not create or duplicate this contribution.

nodes.label: Payroll project allocation
nodes.description: Normalized allocation of an approved or paid payroll entry to a project; draft/calculated labor remains pending.

nodes.label: Direct project expense
nodes.description: Fuel, transport, equipment rental, permit, meal, and other direct expense records linked to a project when allocated.

nodes.label: Expense correction lifecycle
nodes.description: Authoritative expense correction outcomes distinguish unused draft deletion, history-preserving void, visibility-only archive, and visibility restore; confirmed settlement evidence blocks void/delete until Wave 2B3.

nodes.label: Authoritative expense correction RPC boundary
nodes.description: Database preflight and mutation lock the expense, recheck dependencies and confirmed settlements, preserve project/source identity, derive deployment-company permissions, and write audit history.

nodes.label: Engineering Documents register
nodes.description: Project-scoped document register with revision selection, capability-aware actions, and lazy blueprint viewer loading.

nodes.label: Engineering document
nodes.description: Company-scoped engineering document identity, discipline/type metadata, project scope, current revision pointer, and guarded archive/supersede lifecycle.

nodes.label: Document lifecycle
nodes.description: Only an unused DRAFT shell can be deleted; used documents archive or supersede through a reasoned, confirmed lifecycle while revisions and source files remain historical.

nodes.label: Immutable document revision
nodes.description: Append-only revision metadata and private PDF source bound to company, document, and revision identifiers.

nodes.label: Revision lineage guard
nodes.description: Validates document/revision/company/project identity and prevents historical revision references from being rewritten.

nodes.label: Blueprint viewer and redlines
nodes.description: PDF.js/Konva viewer for private real PDFs, revision-scoped normalized annotations, and explicit source/authorization errors.

nodes.label: Revision-scoped drawing annotations
nodes.description: Normalized redline snapshots tied to one document revision; deletion is a status transition for auditability.

nodes.label: Create document or upload revision
nodes.description: Validates PDF bytes/fingerprint and immutable path, uploads privately, then commits metadata through the guarded RPC boundary.

nodes.label: Engineering Storage and RPC boundary
nodes.description: Private engineering-documents Storage plus authenticated document/revision/annotation persistence and compensation behavior.

nodes.label: RFI register
nodes.description: Project RFI list and create/detail surface.

nodes.label: RFI detail and response history
nodes.description: RFI detail with formal response history, lifecycle actions, and immutable document-revision links.

nodes.label: RFI record
nodes.description: Project-scoped question/clarification record with due-date and assignment metadata plus guarded unused-delete, void, and append-only correction paths.

nodes.label: RFI lifecycle
nodes.description: Guarded RFI state transitions: DRAFT → OPEN → ANSWERED → CLOSED, with unused DRAFT deletion, append-only corrections, and VOID as a reasoned terminal state.

nodes.label: RFI · DRAFT
nodes.description: RFI draft before formal opening.

nodes.label: RFI · OPEN
nodes.description: RFI is formally open for response.

nodes.label: RFI · ANSWERED
nodes.description: An open RFI received its final answer.

nodes.label: RFI · CLOSED
nodes.description: Terminal closed RFI.

nodes.label: RFI · VOID
nodes.description: Guarded terminal void RFI with a reason.

nodes.label: Append-only RFI responses
nodes.description: Formal responses and corrections are retained as new response records; final answer transitions OPEN to ANSWERED atomically and never rewrites prior responses.

nodes.label: RFI document-revision links
nodes.description: RFI links store both documentId and revisionId and validate company/project/revision identity.

nodes.label: RFI permission and lifecycle guard
nodes.description: Operation-specific permission and status validation for create/open/respond/close plus confirmed unused-delete and reasoned void actions.

nodes.label: RFI lifecycle action
nodes.description: Application or existing Assistant request to create, open, respond, close, or void an RFI through the guarded domain boundary; Wave 2C adds lifecycle review in the application without expanding Assistant tools.

nodes.label: RFI guarded RPC boundary
nodes.description: Authenticated RFI RPCs plus locked preflight/apply lifecycle RPCs with company/project validation, effective permissions, audit history, and unused-DRAFT deletion only.

nodes.label: Technical Submittals register
nodes.description: Project submittal list and create/detail surface with current-round status.

nodes.label: Submittal round and review detail
nodes.description: Submittal detail with immutable previous rounds, review decisions, and document-revision links.

nodes.label: Technical submittal
nodes.description: Project submittal identity and current formal round status with guarded unused-delete and void/withdrawal correction paths.

nodes.label: Technical Submittal lifecycle
nodes.description: Guarded submittal state path with unused DRAFT deletion, explicit review outcomes, retained resubmission rounds, terminal close, and reasoned void/withdrawal.

nodes.label: Submittal · DRAFT
nodes.description: Initial submittal and first draft round.

nodes.label: Submittal · SUBMITTED
nodes.description: Formal submittal or newly submitted resubmission round.

nodes.label: Submittal · UNDER_REVIEW
nodes.description: Current round is under review.

nodes.label: Submittal · APPROVED
nodes.description: Current round approved.

nodes.label: Submittal · APPROVED_AS_NOTED
nodes.description: Current round approved with notes.

nodes.label: Submittal · REVISE_AND_RESUBMIT
nodes.description: Current round requires a new retained round.

nodes.label: Submittal · REJECTED
nodes.description: Current round rejected.

nodes.label: Submittal · CLOSED
nodes.description: Terminal closed submittal.

nodes.label: Submittal · VOID
nodes.description: Guarded terminal void submittal with a reason.

nodes.label: Immutable submittal rounds
nodes.description: Each resubmission creates a new formal round while retaining previous round identity, metadata, links, and decisions; only a disposable first DRAFT round may be removed with its parent.

nodes.label: Append-only submittal reviews
nodes.description: Review decisions and comments are retained against a specific round number and round ID.

nodes.label: Submittal document-revision links
nodes.description: Round-specific links retain the exact engineering document revision reviewed in that package.

nodes.label: Submittal permission and lifecycle guard
nodes.description: Operation-specific permission, current-round, decision, resubmission, unused-DRAFT deletion, and terminal correction validation.

nodes.label: Submittal lifecycle action
nodes.description: Application or existing Assistant request to create, submit, review, resubmit, close, or void a submittal; application lifecycle review adds guarded correction choices without Wave 3 Assistant expansion.

nodes.label: Submittal guarded RPC boundary
nodes.description: Authenticated submittal RPCs plus locked lifecycle preflight/apply enforce company/project identity, effective permissions, current-round decisions, unused-DRAFT deletion, and immutable history.

nodes.label: Daily Site Log register
nodes.description: Project field-record register with responsive table/cards and detail/editor entry points.

nodes.label: Daily Site Log detail/editor
nodes.description: Field record editor/detail for weather, crew, equipment, safety, narrative fields, lifecycle actions, and history.

nodes.label: Daily Site Log aggregate
nodes.description: Project/date field report with narrative, child observations, actor lineage, lifecycle timestamps, and append-only correction addenda.

nodes.label: Daily Site Log lifecycle
nodes.description: Guarded field-record path: editable DRAFT correction/delete, DRAFT → SUBMITTED → FINALIZED, VOID only for an unfinalized record, and append-only FINALIZED addenda.

nodes.label: Site Log · DRAFT
nodes.description: Editable field record before submission.

nodes.label: Site Log · SUBMITTED
nodes.description: Submitted field record awaiting finalization.

nodes.label: Site Log · FINALIZED
nodes.description: Finalized field record with guarded immutable formal state.

nodes.label: Site Log · VOID
nodes.description: Guarded void field record with reason.

nodes.label: Append-only Site Log correction/addendum
nodes.description: Reasoned correction text appended to a FINALIZED Site Log without changing the original field observations.

nodes.label: Weather and site-condition observation
nodes.description: Practical field observation of condition, temperature, precipitation, wind, humidity, and site condition; not an external weather source of truth.

nodes.label: Crew/headcount observation
nodes.description: Trade/crew/contractor headcount and optionally observed hours for a site log; not payable time or payroll attendance.

nodes.label: Equipment usage observation
nodes.description: Operating/idle hours, operator notes, and observed condition; not the future QR/barcode asset register.

nodes.label: Safety observation
nodes.description: Bounded site observation with severity, action, and resolved/open state; not a full HSE investigation system.

nodes.label: Append-only Site Log event history
nodes.description: Formal lifecycle event records preserve actor, status transition, reason, and timestamp.

nodes.label: Site Log permission and lifecycle guard
nodes.description: Company/project checks, required aggregate validation, formal-state locks, permission-specific gates, unused-draft deletion, and finalized addendum control.

nodes.label: Site Log lifecycle action
nodes.description: Application or existing Assistant request to create/update/submit/finalize/void a Daily Site Log; application lifecycle review adds unused delete and finalized addendum without Wave 3 expansion.

nodes.label: Site Log guarded RPC boundary
nodes.description: Authenticated Site Log aggregate and lifecycle RPCs with active-company permission, project validation, actor lineage, locked preflight, immutable history, and addenda.

nodes.label: Field observation / payroll boundary
nodes.description: Explicitly records that field crew observations have no direct authoritative edge into payroll attendance or payable time.

nodes.label: Invoice source document or email
nodes.description: Uploaded/pasted source or imported email attachment retained with source metadata and provenance.

nodes.label: Invoice extraction workflow
nodes.description: Source bytes/metadata are sent through the existing extraction path and become a reviewable invoice record; extraction does not verify the invoice.

nodes.label: Gemini-compatible extraction boundary
nodes.description: Optional external AI provider used for assistive extraction; provider output is normalized and remains non-authoritative until human review.

nodes.label: Supplier invoice record
nodes.description: Persisted invoice identity, extracted fields, review status, payment presentation, source provenance, correction lifecycle, and review history.

nodes.label: Invoice correction lifecycle
nodes.description: Authoritative invoice correction outcomes distinguish unused-only deletion, history-preserving void, visibility-only archive, and visibility restore; confirmed settlement evidence blocks void/delete until Wave 2B3.

nodes.label: Authoritative invoice correction RPC boundary
nodes.description: Database preflight and mutation lock the invoice, recheck dependencies and confirmed settlements, derive deployment-company permissions, preserve original values, and write audit/review history.

nodes.label: Invoice · VOID
nodes.description: Explicitly voided invoice remains queryable with actor, timestamp, reason, original values, extraction/review history, and allocations preserved; it is excluded from active project cost and new settlement confirmation.

nodes.label: Human invoice verification workspace
nodes.description: Review queue and verification workspace for source comparison, edits, quality warnings, and explicit human verification.

nodes.label: Invoice · NEEDS_REVIEW
nodes.description: Extracted or edited invoice awaiting human verification.

nodes.label: Invoice · VERIFIED
nodes.description: Invoice verified by a human and eligible for authoritative project allocation.

nodes.label: Human verification guard
nodes.description: Verification remains an explicit human action; extracted projectReference is only a text hint until project allocation is confirmed.

nodes.label: Invoice review history
nodes.description: Append-only or snapshot-preserving review metadata used to explain human verification and field changes.

nodes.label: Confirm invoice project allocation
nodes.description: Human-confirmed allocation that makes a verified invoice contribute to project cost without changing invoice verification history.

nodes.label: Verified invoice payable obligation
nodes.description: Cash payable basis uses explicit net-payable semantics when trustworthy, otherwise the gross document amount; it is separate from project cost.

nodes.label: Invoice persistence and review boundary
nodes.description: Company-scoped invoice/source/review persistence and allocation RPC/data boundary.

nodes.label: Bank, e-wallet, and cash accounts
nodes.description: Company financial accounts with currency, opening balance, connection metadata, and masked identifiers; descriptive edits and explicit deactivate/reactivate lifecycles preserve account history.

nodes.label: Statement import and normalization
nodes.description: CSV/XLSX/PDF statement structure is previewed, fingerprints/duplicates are checked, and only a passing preview is committed.

nodes.label: Financial transactions
nodes.description: Imported or manual bank/e-wallet/cash transactions with direction, currency, source fingerprint, and reconciliation status; manual correction is limited to uncommitted rows and used evidence is reversible history.

nodes.label: Cash reconciliation workspace
nodes.description: Account, transaction, candidate, partial/split allocation, confirmation, ignore/review restoration, transfer reversal, and settlement reversal review surface.

nodes.label: Settlement candidates
nodes.description: Deterministic eligible invoice, payroll, and supported expense obligations filtered by posted debit, currency, lifecycle, and remaining amount.

nodes.label: Financial settlement match
nodes.description: Canonical bridge between a financial transaction and an invoice, payroll run, supported expense, or internal transfer.

nodes.label: Confirm settlement allocation
nodes.description: Explicit finance action for a partial, full, or split settlement allocation after candidate and target checks.

nodes.label: Confirmed settlement evidence
nodes.description: Confirmed cash paid, outstanding amount, settlement state, and linked transaction history for an invoice, payroll run, or supported expense.

nodes.label: Settlement match lifecycle
nodes.description: Candidate state is non-authoritative; confirmation creates evidence; settlement reversal records additive history while transaction and transfer corrections use explicit guarded lifecycles.

nodes.label: Settlement · SUGGESTED
nodes.description: Non-authoritative candidate.

nodes.label: Settlement · CONFIRMED
nodes.description: Authoritative payment/disbursement evidence.

nodes.label: Settlement · REJECTED
nodes.description: Rejected or legacy non-authoritative candidate.

nodes.label: Settlement · REVERSED
nodes.description: Previously confirmed match with recorded reversal provenance.

nodes.label: Settlement reversal history
nodes.description: Original match remains with confirmation actor/time; reversal actor/time/reason are added to history.

nodes.label: Internal account transfer
nodes.description: Dedicated two-sided transfer operation kept distinct from supplier invoice, payroll, and expense settlement; reversal locks the exact pair and restores both ledger rows without deletion.

nodes.label: Settlement eligibility and concurrency guard
nodes.description: Revalidates actor, effective permissions, deployment company, POSTED DEBIT direction, target lifecycle, currency, remaining amounts, and idempotency under row locks; correction and transfer lifecycles remain RPC-only.

nodes.label: Settlement RPC boundary
nodes.description: Authenticated guarded RPCs for account lifecycle, manual transaction correction/reversal, ignore/review restoration, single/batch settlement confirmation, settlement reversal, and exact-pair transfer reversal.

nodes.label: Workforce directory
nodes.description: Workers, assignments, departments, compensation profiles, and workforce operations entry point.

nodes.label: Worker identity and assignments
nodes.description: Canonical worker identity, employment metadata, default labor context, and date-ranged project assignments used by time and payroll records; used workers are offboarded rather than erased.

nodes.label: Workforce and payroll correction lifecycle
nodes.description: One correction model for unused deletion, operational offboarding/end/deactivation/cancellation, and finalized-history void/correction. Multiple assignments remain membership context and never duplicate labor cost.

nodes.label: Authoritative workforce lifecycle RPC boundary
nodes.description: Database preflight and mutation boundary that derives deployment company, checks active membership/effective permission, revalidates dependencies under lock, and writes lifecycle audit events.

nodes.label: Default versus actual labor context guard
nodes.description: PROJECT, ADMIN_OFFICE, GENERAL_OVERHEAD, and UNALLOCATED_REVIEW remain explicit. Actual project work wins over defaults; office/overhead/review never become project labor or a fake Main Office project.

nodes.label: Worker compensation profiles
nodes.description: Effective-dated pay basis and recurring components used during deterministic payroll calculation.

nodes.label: Authoritative payroll attendance
nodes.description: Worker/date attendance records normalized and deduplicated for payroll source calculation.

nodes.label: Overtime requests
nodes.description: Period/project-linked overtime requests normalized before approved overtime contributes to calculation.

nodes.label: Leave requests
nodes.description: Worker leave records resolved into payroll source dates and protected when overlapping finalized payroll.

nodes.label: Work/source records and imports
nodes.description: Period-linked work entries plus bounded payroll imports and adjustments that feed deterministic calculation.

nodes.label: Payroll schedule
nodes.description: Company-scoped schedule and effective versions used to generate/open payroll periods without selecting future drafts as current.

nodes.label: Payroll period
nodes.description: Schedule-bound pay horizon with source revision and lock/finalization state.

nodes.label: Payroll run
nodes.description: Calculated payroll snapshot and lifecycle record for one payroll period.

nodes.label: Payroll run lifecycle
nodes.description: DRAFT → CALCULATED → APPROVED → PAID, with explicit terminal VOID and locked historical states.

nodes.label: Payroll run · DRAFT
nodes.description: Editable run before calculation.

nodes.label: Payroll run · CALCULATED
nodes.description: Deterministic calculation snapshot ready for approval checks.

nodes.label: Payroll run · APPROVED
nodes.description: Approved payroll history and project labor allocation source.

nodes.label: Payroll run · PAID
nodes.description: Paid payroll history retained for labor cost and settlement evidence.

nodes.label: Payroll run · VOID
nodes.description: Terminal void run excluded from confirmed labor cost.

nodes.label: Payroll entry calculation snapshot
nodes.description: Per-worker calculated gross/net pay, adjustment, source revision/fingerprint, and project allocation context.

nodes.label: Project labor allocation
nodes.description: Normalized project allocation derived from payroll entries; confirmed only for APPROVED or PAID runs.

nodes.label: Authoritative project labor cost
nodes.description: Confirmed labor cost used by project costing from approved/paid payroll allocations, separate from employee net pay.

nodes.label: Safe project labor aggregate RPC
nodes.description: Authenticated SECURITY DEFINER read boundary that derives deployment company and active membership, requires projects.read plus payroll.summary.read, validates requested projects, and returns project-level confirmed/pending labor totals only.

nodes.label: Employee net-pay settlement basis
nodes.description: Settlement basis is the sum of payroll entry netPay, not gross pay or project-allocated labor cost.

nodes.label: Payroll source freshness and readiness guard
nodes.description: Revalidates period boundaries, source revision/fingerprint, entries, allocations, schedule, and blockers before approval or recalculation.

nodes.label: Payroll history immutability guard
nodes.description: Database and application guards prevent edits to approved/paid/void runs, entries, allocations, and source records that would rewrite history.

nodes.label: Calculate, approve, or pay payroll run
nodes.description: Lifecycle action subject to source freshness, entry/allocation validation, approval/payment authority, and explicit confirmation for Assistant requests.

nodes.label: Payroll persistence and guarded RPC boundary
nodes.description: Company-scoped payroll/workforce persistence, import/rebuild operations, maintenance, Realtime, and database lifecycle guards.

nodes.label: Operational and financial reports
nodes.description: Consolidated project-cost, payroll, cash, and operational report surface with export action.

nodes.label: Derived reporting surface
nodes.description: Reads authoritative domain sources and presents bounded derived views; no report node writes back to financial or payroll source records.

nodes.label: Operational report
nodes.description: Derived operational activity/report view.

nodes.label: Project-cost report
nodes.description: Derived project budget, actual, committed, and remaining-cost view.

nodes.label: Payroll operating-cost report
nodes.description: Derived payroll period/run and labor-cost reporting view.

nodes.label: Cash and settlement report
nodes.description: Derived account, transaction, reconciliation, and settlement-evidence view.

nodes.label: Export report workbook
nodes.description: Exports bounded report views to the existing workbook/report format without creating a new source record.

nodes.label: Reporting non-authority guard
nodes.description: Reports are read/derived/export surfaces and cannot become a parallel source of financial or payroll truth.

nodes.label: Engoryx Assistant panel
nodes.description: Context-aware Assistant panel that can return bounded reads/navigation actions and show prepared actions for confirmation.

nodes.label: Assistant authenticated company context
nodes.description: Server validates bearer session, active company membership/platform access, company header, and per-tool company permission.

nodes.label: Gemini-compatible Assistant model boundary
nodes.description: Server-only company AI runtime and bounded model/tool loop; model output is untrusted input and not a source of truth.

nodes.label: Assistant read request
nodes.description: User question becomes a bounded model request with current route/company context and no mutation authority.

nodes.label: Authorized read tool
nodes.description: Allowlisted read tool validates arguments, checks company permission, and queries company-scoped records.

nodes.label: Allowlisted navigation action
nodes.description: Assistant can navigate to verified records/routes through allowlisted client actions and canonical app path helpers.

nodes.label: Bounded Assistant read/navigation result
nodes.description: Bounded references and safe client navigation actions returned to the current company workspace.

nodes.label: Assistant mutation request
nodes.description: Natural-language mutation request is restricted to an allowlisted prepare tool and deterministic normalized arguments.

nodes.label: Persisted PREPARED action
nodes.description: Preview, normalized args, context generation, expiry, idempotency key, and action event persisted before any mutation executes.

nodes.label: Deterministic action validation
nodes.description: Normalized arguments, identifiers, dates, bounds, current entity state, company scope, and operation-specific preconditions are revalidated.

nodes.label: Explicit human confirmation
nodes.description: User must confirm the persisted preview while context generation and permission checks remain current.

nodes.label: Guarded execution handler
nodes.description: Confirmed action is claimed idempotently, dispatches to deterministic application/domain handlers, and forbids nested preparation.

nodes.label: Assistant guarded RPC/application boundary
nodes.description: Mutation handlers call the same company-scoped RPC/domain boundaries used by the application and record result only after success.

nodes.label: Assistant action event audit record
nodes.description: Company/user-scoped action event retains preview, lifecycle, result/error summary, and idempotency provenance.

nodes.label: Executed Assistant result
nodes.description: Result is marked EXECUTED only after the deterministic handler/RPC succeeds; client actions may then deep-link to the changed record.
